nodes.label: cogpunk-dev skill (operating manual)
nodes.rationale: A task is not done until all applicable directives D0-D5 are checked off with evidence (section 6).

nodes.label: D0 No crashes, guaranteed
nodes.rationale: Top priority, wins every conflict: if a faster or prettier version is riskier, choose the safe one. Never crash game/server/worldgen or cause a console loop.

nodes.label: Vanilla entity/array limits (decompiled v2026.08.3.0)
nodes.rationale: NewProjectile overwrites the oldest projectile; NewNPC returns dummy slot 200; ai[] index past bounds throws; textures not loaded on dedicated server.

nodes.label: D1 Optimization
nodes.rationale: Zero heap allocations, no LINQ or uncached assets in hot paths; visuals client-only; sync only on change.

nodes.label: D2 Co-op compatibility
nodes.rationale: Server decides NPC/world/random outcomes, player projectiles owner-only; tested singleplayer, host+client, dedicated server.

nodes.label: Co-op boss loot via BossBag playerInteraction
nodes.rationale: User 2026-11-05b: bags drop for every player like vanilla; never spawn boss loot directly; tools/check_boss_loot.py must pass.

nodes.label: D3 Balance (vanilla anchor +-15% eff DPS)
nodes.rationale: Every combat stat gets a docs/balance CSV row against a same-tier vanilla anchor, numbers filled before coding.

nodes.label: Expert-first balance rule
nodes.rationale: User 2026-10-27: Cogpunk is played on Expert, so every number is the Expert value; Classic half, Master 1.5x; boss bags Expert/Master only.

nodes.label: Mechanist reach classes (close vs far balance)
nodes.rationale: User 2026-11-24: anchor is the tier melee anchor; close-quarter at +-15%, far-range 10-25% under since reach is its safety.

nodes.label: Tier T0-T10 vanilla anchor and TTK table
Attack-pattern fairness (telegraphs, dodgeability)
nodes.rationale: Telegraph >=30 ticks T0-T4; T0-T4 dodgeable without wings; co-op adds pressure, not guaranteed deaths.

nodes.label: D4 Pixel art
nodes.rationale: 1x drawn, 2x nearest-neighbour export, Cogpunk palette only, top-left light, ramp outlines, no semi-transparent pixels.

nodes.label: Seamless blocks (vanilla ore clump look)
nodes.rationale: No per-tile seams/bevels; outlines only on exposed edges; Rusted Scrap went from seam ratio 3.25 to 0.71.

nodes.label: Art direction for detailed entities (3/4 view, Metal Slug detail, death cinematics)
nodes.rationale: User rule 2026-10-26.

nodes.label: Multiplane parallax layers (far/middle/near)
nodes.rationale: Never rotate/scale at runtime; generator renders every pose so frames stay clean pixel art; RigData.cs keeps art and code from drifting.

nodes.label: Stable pixels: no colour flicker between frames
nodes.rationale: User 2026-10-29: part-space lighting, whole-pixel subtle loops; check_flicker.py must pass.

nodes.label: Vanilla detail density (chibi proportions, long ramps)
nodes.rationale: User 2026-11-05: match Metal Slug-level detail; check_detail.py hard limits.

nodes.label: Sprite quality band and 2x rule (2026-11-23 study)
nodes.rationale: Measured against vanilla, Calamity, Thorium and Lunar Veil; effects may be 1x additive gradients.

nodes.label: D5 Visual proof (GIF/PNG)
nodes.rationale: Any animated result needs a GIF built from frames or a faithful offline simulation; in-game capture not required; self-review before reporting.

nodes.label: Clear outdated docs/media proofs
nodes.rationale: User 2026-10-28: project size; delete GIFs/PNGs of old versions when a model changes.

nodes.label: Core/Safety/SafeSpawn
nodes.rationale: Validates type ids and NaN, refuses instead of overwriting, keeps reserve slots for vanilla (100 projectiles, 20 NPCs), server-only NPC/item spawns.

nodes.label: Core/Safety/SafeLog
nodes.rationale: Reports each key at most 3 times; deferred formatting to avoid console loops.

nodes.label: CogpunkPacket / PacketRegistry
nodes.rationale: Receive validates every index; registry catches exceptions and drops the packet.

nodes.label: SafeGenPass / GenPassUtils.InsertAfter
nodes.rationale: Catches exceptions so world creation continues; falls back to append if anchor pass missing.

nodes.label: Core/Systems/WorldFlagSystem
nodes.rationale: Saves flags by name (never numeric id) and syncs on WorldData.

nodes.label: Core/Templates bases (CogpunkItem/NPC/Projectile/Tile/Wall/Buff)
nodes.rationale: Missing-texture fallback means missing art never blocks loading.

nodes.label: Architecture: Core/ engine vs Content/<Slice>/ feature slices
nodes.rationale: Chosen 2026-10-20 after comparing Calamity, Starlight River and Spirit Reforged; Core never references Content; slices don't reach into each other.

nodes.label: Mechanist class & Steam resource (SteamPlayer, MechanistDamage)
nodes.rationale: User 2026-10-27: steam works like mana, base tank 0 (only gear grants one), overheat when used without enough steam.

nodes.label: Steam as mana / mana as steam (Serene Tear)
Permanent steam and the steam dash (CogpunkerManual)
Core/Templates/BossNPC
nodes.rationale: StateMachineNPC with scripted death; CheckDead refuses killing blow, DyingState then server finishing strike.

nodes.label: Boss-fight rules (defeat card, no natural spawns, biome despawn, summon in shop, manual, +10-35% life)
Floaty bosses (no contact damage, drifting melee approach)
nodes.rationale: User 2026-11-17: facilitate melee combat; never a perfect lock-on.

nodes.label: Core/Visuals/DepthLayers
nodes.rationale: Packed atlas pages instead of grid sheets, which ran out of room at 20 body frames.

nodes.label: Hitboxes match the art (RigData strips, check_hitboxes.py)
CogpunkSets.NeverStolen
nodes.rationale: A thief must not take a one-time drop (manual, key, Combinator part).

nodes.label: Core/Events/CogpunkInvasion
nodes.rationale: Re-implements vanilla goblin-army rules line for line; one invasion at a time.

nodes.label: The Combinator (CombinedWeapon, product = augment rebuilt)
nodes.rationale: Being the augment's type keeps every vanilla shot keyed on sItem.type and every ModItem hook working.

nodes.label: ICombinatorPassives / CombinatorTraits
nodes.rationale: 2026-11-12: compatibility for all future weapons; check_combinator.py fails until each weapon declares what it lends.

nodes.label: Research: knowledge points and node tree
nodes.rationale: Unlocks are per player and permanent; nodes appended at the end because the index is the sync bit.

nodes.label: Secret/teaser research nodes (Reveal, once seen always seen)
nodes.rationale: User 2026-11-18/24: secret nodes beside or below the arch, never above; a reveal never reverts.

nodes.label: Research-locked recipes
nodes.rationale: User 2026-11-18: recipes of listed items hidden until the node unlocks, even ones created before.

nodes.label: Research progress can't be lost or farmed
Using the user's own art (faithful trace, exact in-game sprite)
nodes.rationale: User 2026-11-18/23: never swap the user's design for a simpler redraw; animate by moving its own parts.

nodes.label: Core/Systems/SlowMotion zones
nodes.rationale: At most 4 zones, one tick in five, shared clock, capped at MaxTicks.

nodes.label: Crit-kill slow motion (CritKillSlowMotion, CritSlowMotionPacket)
nodes.rationale: World-wide 12 s cooldown (user); server config can turn it off.

nodes.label: Enemy banners (EnemyBanners ModBannerTile)
nodes.rationale: New enemies appended at the end so placed banners keep their style; bosses get none (user).

nodes.label: The economy (+60% shop/reforge, x0.4 sell, MaxStack 9999)
nodes.rationale: docs/balance/economy.csv; Tavernkeep excluded (user).

nodes.label: Altar recipes generated from the drop database
Core/Safety/StationReach.InReach
nodes.rationale: IsInInteractionRangeToMultiTileHitbox only works for vanilla chests/dressers/piggy banks; it closed the research window as it opened.

nodes.label: Core/Hooks/WaterStyleHooks.Override
nodes.rationale: Main.CalculateWaterStyle never asks ModBiome.WaterStyle on vanilla backgrounds: the Junkyard tar never showed.

nodes.label: Ready for the 1.4.5 port (Core/Hooks last resort)
